Emma T.: quick sync — Client Phoenix asked for a security review call + written evidence: they want the RBAC change window process, audit-log export sample, and KMS key access flow for tenant onboarding. can we do 30m today?
Raj P.: can do 11:30-12:00. FYI we need to include retention policy + where raw logs are pulled from (cloudtrail/syslog).
Olivia (eng-sre): +1. i'll bring the audit retention matrix. quick note: for hosted customers we keep audit-events for 365 days in cold storage, 30 days hot. export command for the portal logs (example):
```bash
# export last 7 days of api-audit logs
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  "https://logs.redwood.example/api/audit?start=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-08T00:00:00Z&format=json" \ 
  -o phoenix-audit-7d.json
```
Samir K.: on RBAC: we apply changes via the RBAC service with an auditable change record. typical flow is: 1) developer opens change request in our internal runbook -> 2) approver (sec/ops) reviews -> 3) change applied via infra-job that writes a signed changelog entry to `rbac-change-log` S3 prefix. We can show the signed log and the job id.
Kate L.: KMS notes — for Dedicated/Private we support tenant-managed keys (BYOK) and Redwood-managed keys. For BYOK we do envelope encryption: data key generated in HSM -> used for volume/kv encryption -> wrapped with tenant KMS key. customer asked about key rotation evidence: we can provide rotation logs showing `GenerateDataKey`/`Encrypt` calls and the wrapping key version. also provide HSM attestation doc if onprem.
Raj P.: vuln triage update: our scanner flagged library `libproto` 2.1.3 (CVE-2026-0456) with a medium vector on parsing untrusted input. mitigation: pinned to 2.2.0 and added an input sanitizer in the request parser. i pushed the remediation PR: #4221. we should capture that in the SQ response (what was found, risk, fix, timeline).
Emma T.: perfect. on incident response / chain of custody — client asked how we handle emergency key rotations and evidence. can someone paste the playbook snippet?
Olivia (eng-sre): from the runbook: 
```text
- IR triage opens IR ticket in Zendesk w/ incident id
- create ephemeral audit snapshot: aws s3 cp s3://rbac-change-log/<prefix> /tmp/ir-snapshot --recursive --metadata-file meta.json
- produce signed manifest: ./sign-manifest --input /tmp/ir-snapshot --key /opt/attest/hsm-key.pem > manifest.sig
- provide manifest.sig + snapshot to customer under NDA
```
Samir K.: also note: we never expose raw KMS root key material. we provide key usage logs + HSM attestation statements. for Dedicated we can offer a live key ceremony with customer ops if they require.
Kate L.: i'll attach the KMS audit example to the thread (sample entries):
